partners_type_attributes.name: partners_type_attributes
partners_type_attributes.value:
("partners"."partner_type" <> 'tenaga_medis' OR "partners"."str_no" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("partners"."partner_type" <> 'fasilitas' OR "partners"."facility_kind" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("partners"."partner_type" <> 'gaya_hidup' OR "partners"."field" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("partners"."partner_type" <> 'apotek' OR "partners"."sia_no" IS NOT NULL)

tariff_change_requests_kind_fields.name: tariff_change_requests_kind_fields
tariff_change_requests_kind_fields.value:
("tariff_change_requests"."kind" = 'tunggal' AND "tariff_change_requests"."service_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tariff_change_requests"."price_type" IS NOT NULL AND "tariff_change_requests"."effective_from" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("tariff_change_requests"."kind" = 'impor' AND "tariff_change_requests"."import_batch_id" IS NOT NULL)

tariff_versions_ask_no_price.name: tariff_versions_ask_no_price
tariff_versions_ask_no_price.value: "tariff_versions"."price_type" <> 'tanya' OR ("tariff_versions"."price_min" IS NULL AND "tariff_versions"."price_max" IS NULL)
